name: Possible heart attack
message: Chest pain together with breathlessness can indicate a heart attack. Call emergency services now — do not drive yourself.

name: Possible heart attack (sweating)
message: Chest pain with sweating can indicate a heart attack. Call emergency services now.

name: Possible stroke
message: Weakness on one side of the body with slurred speech can indicate a stroke. Call emergency services immediately — treatment is time-critical.

name: Possible stroke (facial)
message: Sudden focal weakness with slurred speech can indicate a stroke. Call emergency services immediately.

name: Reduced consciousness
message: Reduced or lost consciousness requires emergency assessment now.

name: Active seizure
message: A seizure with altered consciousness needs emergency assessment.

name: Possible meningitis
message: A stiff neck with high fever can indicate meningitis. Seek emergency care immediately.

name: Vomiting blood
message: Vomiting blood indicates internal bleeding and requires emergency care now.

name: Coughing blood
message: Coughing up blood needs urgent medical assessment — seek care today.

name: Blood in stool
message: Black or tarry stools can indicate internal bleeding. Seek urgent medical assessment.

name: Severe breathing difficulty
message: Difficulty breathing with rapid breathing needs urgent assessment — seek care today.

name: Bleeding in pregnancy
message: Bleeding during pregnancy requires urgent assessment — contact your maternity unit.

name: Postmenopausal bleeding
message: Bleeding after menopause always requires investigation. Book an urgent appointment.
